name: purdy_back
note: Purdy was No. 1 in Week 6, slipped (No. 3 in Week 7, No. 2 in Weeks 8-9), and is No. 1 again after Week 10. Replaces the auto-picked 'new No. 1' story, which only looked at last week.

beats.text: Guess who's back at No. 1 in our model.
Brock Purdy. He led our board earlier this season, slipped for a few weeks, and now he's taken it back.
Here's what jumped out to me. A 115.2 passer rating, 22 total touchdowns, and the Niners are 8-1.
I'll be honest, Joe Burrow's right behind him at No. 2.
Want to see the rest? Full board at stingercollectibles.com
